name: Nanocyte
body:
Nanites. Tiny machines that can grant incredible fortitude, transform into tools, and course across the battlefield to decimate foes. Whether their incorporation stems from accidental infection, excruciating experiments, or voluntary symbiosis, nanites grow stronger as they gradually transform their host into more machine than mortal.

While many nanocytes are driven by their one directive to see technology replace magic entirely, there are those who contain and control their nanites, using them to better the surrounding world. These heroic nanocytes are not always aware of the larger threat their brethren pose, but they can sense something is coming. They adventure to learn not only what that is, but also how to stop it, should it prove a threat to their home.

Role: A nanocyte’s total control over the nanites within him makes the nanocite an adept combatant who can manifest the perfect weapon or tool at a moment’s notice. He can use them to improve himself or his equipment, or affect the area around him to aid allies and hinder enemies.

Alignment: Any.

Hit Die: d6.

Class Skills

The nanocyte’s class skills are Acrobatics (Dex), Appraise (Int), Bluff (Cha), Climb (Str), Craft (Int), Disable Device (Dex), Disguise (Cha), Escape Artist (Dex), Heal (Wis), Intimidate (Cha), Knowledge (arcana) (Int), Knowledge (engineering) (Int), Knowledge (planes) (Int), Perception (Wis), Profession (Wis), Ride (Dex), Sense Motive (Wis), Sleight of Hand (Dex), Stealth (Dex), Swim (Str), and Use Magic Device (Cha).

Skill Ranks per Level: 6 + Int modifier.

Class Features

The following are class features of the nanocyte.

Weapon and Armor Proficiency

Nanocytes are proficient with all simple weapons plus any weapon they form with their nanites. They are proficient with light armor, but not with shields.

Nanite Array (Ex)

A nanocyte’s body hosts a multitude of nanites that he can direct to take one of three forms, called arrays.

The nanites can flood out of his body to form a cloud, combine to temporarily create items, or mobilize within him to amplify his physical abilities.

As a move action, the nanocyte can direct his nanites to adopt an array. He can have only one array active at a time. Alternatively, he can use a nanite surge (see below) to form or switch arrays as a swift action.

Nanites maintain their array until the nanocyte directs them into a different array, dismisses them as a swift action, falls unconscious, or ends his turn more than 10 feet from the array. If an array ends without being turned into a different array, the nanites disperse and return to the nanocyte’s body at the beginning of his next turn, where they await further instructions. If the nanocyte isn’t within 60 feet of the array or the array is physically blocked from reaching him, the nanites instead break down, and he can’t use his nanite array again until he spends 1 minute to create a replacement array.

A nanocyte’s nanites are technological in nature, and they can be detected by spells (such as technomancy), but they aren’t otherwise subject to effects that affect technology. Gear formed by nanites is treated as non-metal (for druids), but can normally be broken or destroyed as if it were steel. The nanocyte can still reform his gear normally.

The three forms of nanite arrays—cloud, gear, and sheath— provide the following benefits only while the specific array is active.

Cloud Array: The nanites spread out into a faintly visible cloud that fills a number of contiguous 5-foot squares. The maximum number of squares the cloud array can fill this way is equal to 1 + the nanocyte’s Constitution modifier (minimum 1), and at least one of those squares must be adjacent to the nanocyte.

The cloud array is stationary once formed, though the nanocyte can reconfigure its space as a move action; if he does so, at least one square of the cloud array must remain unchanged.

When the nanocyte takes a 5-foot-step, he can move 10 feet as long as he begins and ends his movement adjacent to or within his cloud array. This also allows him to take a 5-foot-step even when hampered by difficult terrain (but not darkness), though he still only moves 5 feet in those situations.

At 3rd and 7th level, whenever the nanocyte forms a cloud array, it can fill an additional 5-foot square. At 11th level, the cloud fills up to a number of contiguous 5-foot squares equal to 1 plus twice the nanocyte’s Constitution modifier. At 19th level, the cloud instead fills up to a number of contiguous 5-foot squares equal to 1 plus four times the nanocyte’s Constitution modifier.

Surge—When he forms a cloud array, the nanocyte can use a nanite surge to increase the cloud’s density.

This causes the array’s space to provide concealment, but it provides only a 10% miss chance. It doesn’t provide enough concealment to make a Stealth check, and the nanocyte’s attacks ignore any miss chance provided by his own cloud array. This concealment doesn’t stack with existing concealment. This miss chance increases by 5% at 3rd, 7th, and 15th level, to a total miss chance of 25%.

Gear Array: The nanites shape themselves into a single piece of equipment, such as armor, cybertech, a tool, or a weapon. The nanocyte can direct his nanites to create a limited selection of equipment, divided into major forms and minor forms. Major forms include weapons and cybertech; minor forms include technological items (excluding armor and weapons) and personal items. At 1st level, the nanocyte knows how to create two major forms and three minor forms. A nanocyte learn a new minor form at 2nd level and every 2 levels thereafter; he learn a new major form at 3rd level, 5th level, and every 4 levels thereafter. When he gain a nanocyte level, he can replace one of his major forms with a new major form and one of his minor forms with a new minor form.

To select a piece of equipment as one of his gear array’s major or minor forms, its value in gold must be equal to or lower than the gear value listed on Table: Nanocyte. Augmentations must be cybertech, weapons and items must be non-magical, and he can’t select equipment that’s consumed on use (such as alchemist’s fire) or whose weight exceeds his heavy load when calculated using Constitution instead of Strength.

When he use his gear array to create a handheld nanite weapon, technological item, or personal item, he can automatically grab and begin wielding it if he have the requisite number of hands free. Otherwise, the item floats in his space until the end of his turn, at which point it drops in his space.

When he use his gear array to create a cybernetic implant, it’s automatically installed in the appropriate body slot as long as that slot is empty; otherwise, it fails to manifest. If a given item has a limited number of uses or frequency, that limit applies regardless of how many times he’ve created it with his gear array. Equipment that requires a battery or ammunition to function must be loaded to function. When the nanocyte creates such equipment, he can have it absorb and automatically load one appropriately-sized battery or set of suitable ammunition in his possession (treat as a quiver or equivalent gear). Any item that uses a battery with fewer than 20 charges can instead use a standard battery.

Surge—The nanocyte can use a nanite surge to drain a magic item in his possession and store its properties to be applied when he forms gear that can use it. Adding properties always requires the nanocyte to use a nanite surge, and the total value must still be within his limit.

Sheath Array: Nanites reinforce the nanocyte’s body, granting him temporary hit points equal to half his nanocyte level (minimum 3) and a +1 insight bonus to Reflex saving throws and checks with two of the following skills selected when he forms this array: Acrobatics, Climb, Escape Artist, Ride, Sleight of Hand, Stealth, or Swim. At 3rd level and every 4 levels thereafter, these bonuses increase by 1.

Surge—When he forms a sheath array, the nanocyte can use a nanite surge to gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to his nanocyte level (minimum 6) that last until the sheath array ends.

Nanite Surge (Ex)

In certain situations, a nanocyte can use a nanite surge to push his nanites to perform extraordinary abilities. He can do this a number of times per day equal to half his nanocyte level plus his Constitution modifier; the exact benefits vary by circumstance and are explained in the talents and other class features here.

Beginning at 5th level, when he has no more uses of nanite surge, a nanocyte can use any of his nanocyte abilities as a full-round action to gain their surge effect.

Only abilities that normally require less than a full-round action to activate can be used in this way.

Primary Nanite Faculty

Whether by design or innovation, a nanocyte’s nanites excel at a specialized task. Choose a primary nanite faculty upon taking the first level in nanocyte—once made, this choice can’t be changed. A full list of faculties and their benefits can be found at the end of this section.

Faculty Techniques

At 1st level and every 4 levels thereafter, he gain a faculty technique unique to his primary nanite faculty.

Defensive Dispersal (Ex)

At 2nd level, a nanocyte can use a nanite surge as an immediate action when he takes damage to protect himself with his nanites by creating a temporary barrier or cause part of his body to temporarily disperse. The nanocyte reduces the damage dealt by the triggering effect by an amount equal to his nanocyte level plus his Constitution modifier, and he gains a +2 circumstance bonus to the first saving throw against the effect (such as the initial saving throw to resist a poison, but not subsequent saves against it).

Nanocyte Talents

As a nanocyte gains experience, he learns special ways to use his nanites called nanocyte talents. A nanocyte learns his first nanocyte talent at 2nd level, and he learns an additional talent every 2 levels thereafter. Beginning at 10th level, the nanocyte can select advanced talents any time he would gain a nanocyte talent.

If a nanocyte talent allows a saving throw to resist its effects, the DC is equal to 10 + half his nanocyte level + his Constitution modifier.

A nanocyte can’t learn the same talent more than once unless otherwise stated.

Cyto-Conversion (Ex)

At 3rd level, as a nanocyte’s connection to his nanites grows, their ability to break down and reassemble his body strengthens, gradually making him more machine than mortal. The nanocyte receives a +2 circumstance bonus to saving throws against bleed, disease, poison, and sleep effects. In addition, he gains a 10% chance to treat a critical hit against him as a normal hit; it deals normal damage and doesn’t apply any effect that would trigger from a critical hit. This percentage doesn’t stack with similar effects, such as fortification.

At 10th level, the circumstance bonus to saving throws increases to +3, and the chance to treat a critical hit against him as a normal hit increases to 20%.

At 16th level, the circumstance bonus to saving throws increases to +4, and the chance to treat a critical hit against him as a normal hit increases to 30%.

Manifold Array (Ex)

At 7th level, with improved command of his nanites, a nanocyte can split them into multiple arrays: A more potent primary array and a weaker secondary array. A nanocyte’s primary array calculates its effects using his full nanocyte level, whereas his secondary array calculates its effects using his nanocyte level –4. A nanocyte can create and sustain multiple clouds or pieces of gear simultaneously, though he can sustain only a single sheath array at a time. A nanocyte must use separate actions to direct his nanites into each array.

At 15th level, a nanocyte can split his array into three forms simultaneously: a primary form using his full level to calculate its effects, a secondary form using his level –4, and a tertiary form using his level –8.

Secondary Nanite Faculty

At 9th level, a nanocyte chooses another nanite faculty. Once he chooses this second faculty, it can’t be changed. He gains the techniques associated with his secondary nanite faculty as a nanocyte of his level –8, but uses his full nanocyte level to determine their effects.

Eternal Nanites (Ex)

At 11th level, a nanocyte’s nanites recover quickly even from the most exhausting tasks. He can rest for 5 minutes and regain a daily use of his nanite surge ability; at 18th level, he regain 2 daily uses instead.

The nanocyte can use this ability a number of times per day equal to his Constitution modifier.

Living Legion (Ex)

At 19th level, the effective level of a nanocyte’s secondary nanite array increases to his level –2, and the effective level of his tertiary nanite array increases to his level –4.

Once per day as a move action, the nanocyte can supercharge his nanites, causing them to multiply and expand for 1 minute, granting him 10 temporary nanite surges. These temporary nanite surges are spent first, and any unused temporary nanite surges disappear at the end of this minute.

Infinite Array (Ex)

Once per day at 20th level, when a nanocyte dies, he can activate an emergency healing protocol. Using this ability on himself takes no action. At the beginning of the nanocyte’s next turn, his body and equipment disperse into a nanite mist, fly up to 30 feet, and reform; restoring him to life in the process. The nanocyte reappears upright and wielding any combination of equipment in his possession, and he regains hit points equal to his level times his Constitution modifier. A nanocyte can then act on his turn as normal. A nanocyte whose body is destroyed entirely (such as with disintegration) cannot return to life with this ability.

As an immediate action, a nanocyte can instead use a nanite surge to use this ability on an adjacent ally when they die under the same conditions. The nanocyte can also use additional nanite surges when he uses this ability to increase the distance at which he can target that ally by up to 20 feet for each additional surge used in this way. The ally disperses, flies, and reforms at the beginning of their next turn.

Absorption (Nanite Faculty)

The nanocyte’s body absorbs attacks, swallowing bullets, toxins, and even magic that his nanites convert into bursts of power.

Vanish into the Depths (Ex)

The nanocyte gains the defensive dispersal ability at 1st level instead of 2nd level. He adds 1/2 his nanocyte level to the amount by which his defensive dispersal ability reduces the damage dealt by a triggering effect.

Fuel for the Fires (Ex)

At 5th level, the nanocyte can repurpose incoming damage, using it to make his own attacks deadlier. When he uses his defensive dispersal ability to reduce the damage he takes from an effect, the nanocyte enhances the next attack he makes with a weapon created by his gear array made before the end of his next turn. If the attack hits, it deals 1d6 additional damage. This additional damage increases by 1d6 at 9th level, 13th level, and 17th level.

Alternatively, when a creature in the nanocyte’s cloud array takes damage before the end of his next turn, the nanocyte can expend his absorbed energy to increase the damage the creature takes by 1d6 (increased to 2d6 at 9th level, 3d6 at 13th level, and 4d6 at 17th level).

Either form of additional damage is of the same type as the attack’s normal damage.

Kinetic Surge (Ex)

At 9th level, when the nanocyte uses his defensive dispersal ability to reduce the damage he takes from an attack, he converts some of that energy into rapid movement, granting him a +10-foot enhancement bonus to each of his speeds until the end of his next turn. During this time, the nanocyte is considered to have a running start when making Acrobatics checks to jump.

If the triggering attack for defensive dispersal was a critical hit, increase the enhancement bonus to speed to 20 feet, and the nanocyte also gains a +4 insight bonus to his Armor Class against attacks of opportunity that he provokes by leaving a threatened square until the end of his next turn.

Arcane Turnabout (Ex)

At 13th level, the circumstance bonus to saving throws provided by defensive dispersal increases to +4 against spells and spell-like abilities. When the nanocyte uses his defensive dispersal ability against a spell or spell-like ability and succeeds against the effect’s initial saving throw (or if the spell fails to overcome his Spell Resistance, if any), he can deflect some of the magical energy to damage a creature within 30 feet. That creature takes 1d6 force damage per level of the spell (Fortitude half), and if he targets the spell’s caster with this effect, they take a –2 penalty to the saving throw.

Deflective Dome (Ex)

At 17th level, the nanocyte gains the Group Dispersal talent; if he already has that talent, the nanocyte gains a talent of his choice for which he meets the requirements and that’s available to a 10th-level or lower nanocyte.

Once per minute, when the nanocyte uses his Group Dispersal talent, he can apply its benefits to all allies affected by the triggering effect who are adjacent to him or within his cloud array.

Discorporation (Nanite Faculty)

Nanites rapidly break down and reform the nanocyte’s body, granting him extraordinary flexibility and the ability to melt into an amorphous form.

Reactive Spray (Ex)

At 1st level, when the nanocyte takes damage from an enemy with total Hit Dice no less than his nanocyte level –4, the nanocyte can, as an immediate action, form a temporary cloud array using his nanocyte level to determine the cloud’s size and effects. This cloud lasts until the end of the nanocyte’s next turn and doesn’t count against the maximum number of arrays that he can maintain simultaneously.

If the triggering attack was a critical hit, the nanocyte can also take a 5-foot-step immediately after creating the cloud as part of that action.

Slithering Shape (Ex)

At 5th level, by using a nanite surge as a move action, the nanocyte can melt his body and equipment into a shapeless pool of his size consisting of nanites. This is a polymorph effect.

The nanocyte can remain in his slithering shape form for 1 minute per nanocyte level or until he reverts to his natural form as a move action, though he can extend the duration by an additional 1 minute per nanocyte level by using an additional nanite surge. While transformed in this way:

His speed is 20 feet.
He gains darkvision with a range of 30 feet
He can move through an area as small as one-quarter of his own space without squeezing, and he can squeeze through openings as small as 1 inch wide.
He gains a circumstance bonus equal to his Constitution modifier to Escape Artist checks and to his CMD to resist being grappled or pinned.
He gains DR 5/ magic; this doesn’t stack with other forms of Damage Reduction.
He is unable to speak, attack, cast spells, use items, or perform tasks that require fine manual dexterity while transformed.
Fluid Form (Ex)

At 9th level, the nanocyte’s body easily liquefies and bends around devastating attacks.

He is immune to death from massive damage and increases his cyto-conversion resistance to critical hits by 10%. When he uses defensive dispersal, the nanocyte can also activate his reactive spray ability as part of the same immediate action.

Nanosmoke (Ex)

At 13th level, when the nanocyte activates his slithering shape ability, he can instead transform into a thick nanite vapor. This functions as a non-magical gaseous form effect.

Swarm Shadow (Ex)

At 17th level, once per day as a standard action, the nanocyte can disperse his body and equipment into nanites that form a barely perceptible shell around an adjacent ally. He provides his ally the benefits of his sheath array, including those gained from using nanite surges or from talents that affect his sheath array. While in this form, the nanocyte shares his ally’s space, automatically moves where they move, and has concealment, allowing him to hide in plain sight. He can maintain this passive form for up to 1 hour per nanocyte level, and he can end the effect as a move action, appearing in any empty space adjacent to his ally. If no such space exists, the nanocyte appears in his ally’s space, squeezing both until either can move away.

While in this form, the nanocyte can’t use equipment, but he can create two semisolid limbs that extend from his ally and share their reach, giving him two hands with which to wield equipment he create using one or more gear arrays. If he takes a move action, standard action, full-round action, or attack of opportunity while in this form, the form begins to destabilize, reducing the effect’s remaining duration to 1 round per nanocyte level.

Infestation (Nanite Faculty)

Nanites burrow into the nanocyte’s foes, inflicting grievous injuries as they consume their victims from the inside.

Malignant Mist (Ex)

At 1st level, when the nanocyte forms a cloud array or sheath array, he can use a nanite surge to damage anyone who makes contact with those nanites. The cloud array deals 1d6 piercing damage (Fort negates) to each creature that starts its turn in or enters the cloud’s area. The sheath array deals 1d6 piercing damage (Fort negates) to any creature that hits the nanocyte with a melee weapon without reach, natural attack, or unarmed strike. After a creature attempts a saving throw against either effect, it becomes immune to damage from the same nanocyte’s malignant mist for 1 minute. The nanocyte is immune to the effects of his own malignant mist. The damage dealt by this ability increases to 1d8 at 3rd level, to 2d6 at 5th level, and by 1d6 every 2 nanocyte levels thereafter.

This ability works against constructs.

As an immediate action, the nanocyte can grant one creature he can see within 30 feet of him immunity to his malignant mist until the beginning of his next turn.

Tenacious Swarm (Ex)

At 5th level, when a creature fails a Fortitude save against the nanocyte’s malignant mist ability, they become infested with short-lived nanites that continue burrowing into their body. At the end of the infested creature’s turn, it takes piercing damage equal to his malignant mist ability’s minimum damage plus his Constitution modifier, after which it attempts a new Fortitude save to end the effect. This effect ends automatically after a number of rounds equal to the nanocyte’s Constitution modifier. A creature can only be affected by a single tenacious swarm at a time.

Toxic Host (Ex)

At 9th level, when the nanocyte uses his malignant mist ability, he can make the nanites toxic in nature. Toxic nanites deal half damage to creatures that successfully save against his malignant mist ability.

Noxious Nanites (Ex)

At 13th level, A creature affected by the nanocyte’s tenacious swarm ability is also sickened for the duration of the effect. Weapons the nanocyte forms with his gear array cause the target to become nauseated on a critical hit. A successful Fortitude saving throw negates the nausea, but does not have an effect on the damage.

Engineered Contagion (Ex)

At 17th level, the nanocyte can activate his malignant mist ability once per minute without using a nanite surge. He can also use a nanite surge as a swift action when he activates malignant mist to infect up to two other creatures that he can see who are adjacent to the first and within 60 feet of the nanocyte. The new targets are immediately affected by malignant mist, receiving a saving throw to reduce the effects as normal.

Obliteration (Nanite Faculty)

Nanites mercilessly tear apart the nanocyte’s enemies, whether by guiding his strikes to inflict severe damage or exploding from his attacks to simultaneously hurt multiple foes.

Unstoppable Nanites (Ex)

At 1st level, Weapons the nanocyte forms with his gear array ignore an amount of hardness equal to his Constitution modifier. As a standard action, the nanocyte can make a single attack with a weapon formed with his gear array. On a hit, that weapon deals 1d4 additional damage of the same type.

At 5th level, the additional damage increases to 1d6, and it increases by an additional 1d6 at 9th, 13th, and 17th levels.

Energized Swarm (Ex)

At 5th level, While wielding a weapon he formed with his gear array, the nanocyte can take a swift action to change half or all the weapon’s damage type to cold, electricity, or fire until the beginning of his next turn. If the weapon already has two damage types, choose one to replace.

Spreading Swarm (Ex)

At 9th level, weapons the nanocyte forms with his gear array deal a minimum amount of damage equal to his Constitution modifier plus any enhancement bonuses they may have. The nanocyte can choose to deal the weapon’s normal damage instead.

The first time on the nanocyte’s turn that he hits with a weapon formed with his gear array, he can deal damage equal to his Constitution modifier or that weapon’s minimum damage (whichever is higher) to a different target creature within 10 feet of the original target. The second creature can attempt a Reflex save to take half damage.

Flashing Nanites (Ex)

At 13th level, when taking a full-attack action entirely with weapons formed from his gear array, the nanocyte take a –3 penalty on each of his iterative attack rolls instead of the normal –5 penalty. So a nanocyte with a +13 base attack bonus would make his subsequent attacks at +10 and +7, instead of +8 and +3.

Microscopic Bombardment (Ex)

At 17th level, the nanocyte’s spreading swarm target can be up to 20 feet away from his initial target. In addition, the nanocyte can use a nanite surge before taking a full-attack action to apply his spreading swarm ability to all of his attacks.

Redirection (Nanite Faculty)

The nanocyte’s nanites are forceful and energetic; they can redirect attacks, move objects, and lend weapons devastating mass.

Seeking Strike (Ex)

At 1st level, as a move action, the nanocyte can designate a target within 60 feet that’s inside or adjacent to his nanite cloud as his nanites’ focus, enhancing his accuracy against that target. While the target is the nanites’ focus, each attack the nanocyte makes against the target gains a +1 insight bonus to the attack roll and ignores the target’s concealment (but not total concealment). At 5th level, the nanocyte can declare his nanites’ focus as a swift action instead.

Particle Push (Ex)

At 5th level, the nanocyte can condense his nanites into powerful waves that collide with creatures and objects. While his nanite cloud is within his reach, the nanocyte can attempt bull rush, reposition, and trip combat maneuvers against targets in his nanite cloud as though they were within his melee reach; when doing so, the nanocyte can use his Constitution modifier for his combat maneuver check instead of his Strength modifier.

Bend Bullet (Ex)

At 9th level, attacks the nanocyte makes with his seeking strike ability also reduce the AC bonus from cover (but not total cover) by 2.

When the nanocyte uses his seeking strike with a weapon he formed with his gear array to make a ranged attack against his nanites’ focus, the nanocyte can use one or more nanite surges to alter the attack’s path to avoid obstacles and allies. Up to a distance equal to the weapon’s first range increment, the nanocyte can trace out any path for the attack that doesn’t turn more than 90 degrees per 5 feet traveled, potentially allowing the attack to avoid cover or total cover. Using this ability requires the nanocyte to use one nanite surge for every two times his attack changes direction, rounded up.

Rebounding Strike (Ex)

At 13th level, After using his defensive dispersal ability to reduce the damage he takes from a ranged or melee weapon attack from an attacker within 30 feet of him, the nanocyte can use an additional nanite surge to redirect some of that energy back at the attacker; the target takes an amount of piercing damage equal to the amount by which the nanocyte’s defensive dispersal reduced the triggering attack (Fort negates).

Particle Tsunami (Ex)

At 17th level, As a full-round action, the nanocyte can target up to three different creatures with his particle push ability. For each target, the nanocyte chooses whether to attempt a bull rush, reposition, or trip combat maneuver. He performs each combat maneuver check with a –4 penalty, though before attempting an attack, the nanocyte can use a nanite surge to reduce the penalty to –2 for the first check.

Regeneration (Nanite Faculty)

Nanites swiftly knit flesh, stabilize life signs, and heal superficial wounds—both the nanocyte’s and those of nearby allies.

Reactive Repair (Ex)

At 1st level, as a swift action, the nanocyte can use a nanite surge to direct his nanites to repair and reinforce an ally. The target must either be adjacent to the nanocyte or be adjacent to or within the nanocyte’s nanite cloud. Alternatively, the nanocyte can target himself with this ability. For 1 minute, or until the target begins their turn no longer adjacent to the nanocyte or adjacent to or within the nanocyte’s cloud array, the target gains fast healing 1. At 5th level and every 4 levels thereafter, the fast healing increases by 1.

Nanomedicine (Ex)

At 5th level, the nanocyte can adds his Constitution modifier to his Wisdom modifier when making Heal checks. He can use the Heal skill to treat creatures within or adjacent to his cloud array as though he were adjacent to them. He can use a nanite surge to apply first aid as a swift action or to treat deadly wounds as a full-round action for a creature in his cloud.

Flesh Donor (Ex)

At 9th level, when the nanocyte regains hit points from his reactive repair ability, he can use a nanite surge as an immediate action to multiply the number of hit points he regains that round by 2.

When an ally within 30 feet regains hit points from the nanocyte’s reactive repair ability, the nanocyte can use an immediate action to transfer a number of his own hit points to that creature, up to an amount equal to three times the nanocyte’s level.

From the Brink (Ex)

At 13th level, as a standard action, the nanocyte can use up to 3 nanite surges and restore a dead creature to life so long as that creature died up to a number of rounds ago equal to the number of surges used in this way. This otherwise functions as a non-magical breath of life effect and requires a Heal check to treat deadly wounds.

Healing Swarm (Ex)

At 17th level, the nanocyte effortlessly heals any damage dealt to him as his nanites endlessly repair his body. The first time each round that he uses a nanite surge, the nanocyte can recover up to 2d6 Hit Points.

Nanocyte Talents

All of the following talents are available to any nanocyte who meets their requirements. Unless stated otherwise, the nanocyte can only select each talent once.

Talents marked with an asterisk (*) are advanced talents and have a general prerequisite of 10th-level or higher nanocyte.

Abundant Nanites (Ex)

Your body houses a seemingly inexhaustible amount of nanites. You treat your Constitution modifier as 2 higher when calculating your number of nanite surges per day, and you can use your Constitution score in place of Strength when determining your carrying capacity and maximum loads.

Adaptable Weaponry* (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): 10th-level nanocyte.

Your nanites capably innovate new features when you manifest nanite weapons. Choose two of the following special weapon features: Blocking, brace, deadly, disarm, distracting, grapple, sunder, or trip. Each time you form a weapon using your gear array, you can apply one of the selected special weapon properties to that weapon.

Special: You can select this talent multiple times; each time, select two additional special weapon features and add them to your list of available properties (you still apply only one at a time).

Agile Host (Ex)

While your sheath array is active, you can apply its bonus to skill checks as an insight bonus to your initiative checks.

Alacritous Form* (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): 10th-level nanocyte.

Once per day, at the beginning of your turn, you can use one nanite surge as a free action to grant yourself a non-magical haste effect for a number of rounds equal to your nanocyte level.

Special: You can select this talent more than once.

If you have selected it at least 3 times, you can create your haste effect as a standard action, gaining the spell’s full range and targets.

All-Seeing Nanites* (Ex)

Prerequisites: Sensory Nanites, 10th-level nanocyte.

Your nanites’ sensors are especially acute. You gain blindsight with a range of 5 feet. This blindsight also extends to any area in or adjacent to your nanite cloud.

Special: You can select this talent twice. The second time, you gain the following benefit. As an immediate action, after you touch a target, strike a target with a weapon formed with your gear array, or are hit by an adjacent creature’s melee attack, natural attack, or unarmed strike, you can use a nanite surge to adhere a tiny nanite tracker to that creature or object; a creature can attempt a Reflex save to negate this effect. These nanites resonate with the rest of your nanite array, allowing you to sense the target as though you had blindsight with a range of 120 feet. In addition, you can track the target with a base DC of 10 regardless of the ground conditions, and you can use Perception in place of Survival to track the target. The tracking nanites remain active for a number of days equal to your Constitution modifier.

Become Legion* (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): 18th-level nanocyte.

Once per day, as a move action, you can use a nanite surge to transform into a nanite fog, during which you can take no actions except those granted to you by this ability. This is a polymorph effect, and it counts against the number of arrays you can have active.

While transformed:

You’re a Gargantuan construct made up of Fine-sized nanites.
You have the swarm subtype, a space of 20 feet, and a reach of 0 feet. You can occupy the same space as other creatures.
As a standard action on the round you transform, or whenever you concentrate to maintain the transformation, you can also make a swarm attack that automatically deals 4d6 piercing damage to creatures within your nanite fog. You can ignore a number of creatures in your nanite fog up to your Constitution modifier.
You gain swarm traits (except immunity to single-target mind-affecting effects) and swarm immunities. These immunities don’t end effects from which you suffered before transforming.
When dealing swarm damage to creatures in your space, you can avoid damaging a number of creatures up to your Constitution modifier.

This transformation lasts for as long as you concentrate on it as a standard action, up to 1 minute.If you fail to concentrate, the transformation ends, and you re-form in an empty space your swarm body occupied.

If you’re reduced to 0 Hit Points, the transformation ends automatically.

Special: You can use 10 nanite surges as a full-round action to regain your use of this ability. When you do, you transform as part of that action. If you are under the effects of haste, you can also make a swarm attack.

Biometric Theft* (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): 10th-level nanocyte.

Your nanites can modify your features in subtle ways, allowing you to attempt a Disguise check in place of Disable Device or Use Magic Device checks to act as a member of another ancestry or heritage. As an immediate action, when you touch a creature or hit it with a melee attack, you can use a nanite surge to absorb a sample of the target’s DNA. You can store a number of samples equal to your Constitution modifier at any time. If you absorb another sample and exceed this maximum, you erase one sample of your choice.

In addition, if you have the Facial Reconfiguration talent you can use it to take the appearance of any creatures whose samples you have. This does not alter your mannerisms or personality, and you must still act in character to pass yourself off as a specific individual.

Charge Vampire* (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): 14th-level nanocyte.

When you damage a creature in your nanite cloud or when you damage a creature within 30 feet using a weapon formed with your gear array, you can drain power from the target’s equipment as an immediate action. Choose one item in the target’s possession that uses charges (such as a staff, a wand or some technological devices) or select a qualifying item at random. That item loses a number of charges up to 1d10 plus your Constitution modifier (Fortitude half), and an item in your possession with an equal or lower caster level gains an equal number of charges (to a maximum of that item’s capacity). You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to your Constitution modifier.

Deconstructor* (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): 14th-level nanocyte.

Weapons you form with your gear array and your faculty abilities deal additional damage equal to your Constitution modifier to constructs, objects, and creatures with the technological subtype. In addition, these attacks and abilities ignore an amount of hardness equal to your nanocyte level. If you have unstoppable nanites, this stacks with that ability, but not with other abilities that ignore hardness.

Defensive Doppelganger* (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): 10th-level nanocyte.

When you create a cloud array, you can use a nanite surge to cause a portion of your cloud array to form lifelike replicas of you that shadow and mimic your movements, creating a non-magical mirror image effect.

The duplicates exist until they’re destroyed or you leave the cloud’s area.

Enhanced Immunities (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): 6th-level nanocyte.

Your nanites reinforce your body, staving off even grave threats to your health. If you succeed at a Fortitude saving throw against an effect that has a reduced effect on a successful save, you instead avoid the effect entirely. If you fail, you can use a nanite surge to suffer the reduced effect instead.

Esoteric Edge (Ex)

You gain proficiency with a martial or exotic weapon of your choice and add that weapon as a bonus major form you can create with your gear array.

Special: You can select this talent more than once. Each time, select a new martial or exotic weapon.

Facial Reconfiguration (Ex)

Prerequisites: Versatile Nanites (Disguise), 6th-level nanocyte.

Your nanites can harmlessly reshape your body in increasingly dramatic ways. While your sheath array is active, you can use the Disguise skill to change your appearance with 1d3 minutes of work; you can use one nanite surge to reduce this required time to a full action.

You reduce the check’s DC modifiers by an amount equal to half your nanocyte level (to a minimum DC modifier of +0).

Feasting Nanites* (Ex)

Prerequisites: Hungry Nanites, 10th-level nanocyte.

Your nanites break down and repurpose your foes’ vital fluids to fuel their host. Whenever the target of your hungry nanites takes bleed damage from that ability and is within 30 feet of you, you regain an equal number of hit points, to a maximum number of hit points regained each day equal to three times your nanocyte level.

Group Dispersal* (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): 10th-level nanocyte.

Your nanites protect your companions as readily as they protect you. You can use your defensive dispersal on any ally you can see who’s adjacent to you or within your cloud array. When you use your defensive dispersal on yourself, any adjacent allies also gain the benefits of that ability against the triggering attack or effect. However, only you benefit from additional talents or other abilities that provide any additional effects when you use defensive dispersal in this way.

Heavy Armor Edge (Ex)

Your nanites allow you to move comfortably while wearing thick gear. You gain proficiency with medium and heavy armor, and you add one suit of medium or heavy armor of your choice as a bonus major form you can create with your gear array.

Heavy Weapon Edge (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): 6th-level nanocyte.

You know how to deal damage with big weapons.

While your sheath array is active or you have a twohanded weapon formed with your gear array, your attacks made with two-handed weapons deal additional damage equal to your Constitution modifier. Add one two-handed weapon of your choice as a bonus major form you can create with your gear array.

Hungry Nanites (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): 6th-level nanocyte.

Your nanites tear and gnaw on creatures you designate. After a creature takes damage in your nanite cloud or you damage a creature within 30 feet with a weapon formed with your gear array, you can use an immediate action to cause the creature to bleed for 1d6 damage per round (Fort negates). While the bleeding creature is within your cloud array, the Heal DC to stop the bleeding condition increases by an amount equal to half your nanocyte level plus your Constitution modifier. After using this ability, you can’t use it again until you rest for at least 5 minutes.

Special: You can select this talent again at 10th, 14th, and 18th level. Each time, increase the bleed damage dealt by +2.

Instant Architect (Ex)

Prerequisites: Instant Barricade, 6th-level nanocyte.

As a standard action, you can use a nanite surge and create a non-magical tiny hut effect. At 14th level and higher, you can use 2 nanite surges and create a non-magical instant fortress that lasts for up to 1 hour instead. You can increase the duration of the fortress by 1 hour for every additional nanite surge you use beyond the initial, up to 9 total hours for 10 surges.

Instant Barricade (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): 6th-level nanocyte.

You gain proficiency with shields (but not tower shields) and add a shield of your choice as a bonus major form you can create with your gear array.

Menacing Pall* (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): 14th-level nanocyte.

Your cloud array becomes a deadly fog that can strike those within from any angle. While you’re adjacent to or within your nanite cloud, you can make melee attacks with weapons formed with your gear array from any square occupied by your nanite cloud. This allows you to gain position-based benefits such as avoiding cover or flanking an enemy. This ability doesn’t allow you to see targets that you couldn’t otherwise perceive. You can’t use this ability to perform attacks of opportunity.

Myriad Forms (Ex)

You learn three additional minor forms that you can create with your gear array.

Special: You can select this nanocyte talent more than once.

Omnipresent Form* (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): 18th-level nanocyte.

You can use a nanite surge as a move action to teleport to any location so long as your starting point and destination are both adjacent to a square that contains your nanite cloud; this movement doesn’t provoke attacks of opportunity.

Omniscient Nanites* (Ex)

Prerequisites: All-Seeing Nanites, Sensory Nanites, 18th-level nanocyte.

Nothing escapes the notice of your nanites. The range of your blindsight granted by the All-Seeing Nanites talent increases to 20 feet. This blindsight also extends to any area to which your nanite cloud has line of effect. Your blindsight can penetrate barriers, but 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, a thin sheet of lead, or 3 feet of wood or dirt blocks it.

Finally, when you apply a nanite tracker to a target using the All-Seeing Nanites talent, you can sense the target at a range of a number of miles equal to your Constitution modifier.

Rapid Reshape* (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): 10th-level nanocyte.

Every 1d4 rounds, you can form or switch nanite arrays as a swift action without using a nanite surge.

Resurrectionist* (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): 14th-level nanocyte.

You either gain the from the brink faculty technique or add three rounds to the time you have to bring a creature back to life with that technique. At 20th level, if you have the regeneration faculty, you gain an additional use of infinite array that you can only use on an ally.

Sensory Nanites (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): 6th-level nanocyte.

Nothing that disturbs your nanite cloud escapes your attention. You gain blindsense with a range of 5 feet.

This blindsense also extends to any area in or adjacent to your cloud array.

Split Manifestation (Ex)

When using your gear array to form a light or onehanded weapon, you can manifest a second copy of that weapon. This counts as only one array for determining the number of arrays you have active.

Sudden Transformation (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): 6th-level nanocyte.

You can use an immediate action to form a nanite array. After using this ability the first time each day, you must use a nanite surge each time you use it again.

Surgical Host (Ex)

While your sheath array is active, you can perform Heal checks on creatures in or adjacent to your cloud array as though they were within your reach. You are always considered to have a healer’s kit on hand. At 5th level, you are always considered to have a masterwork healer’s kit on hand instead. At 8th level, you are also considered to have surgeon’s tools.

Swarm Strike (Ex)

When you form your sheath array, you can use a nanite surge to gain a special unarmed strike that deals 1d6 damage. You can deal lethal damage with this unarmed strike, and you can use your Constitution modifier in place of your Strength modifier for attack and damage rolls when using it.

Using a swarm strike requires you to have at least one hand free. For each attack, you can deal bludgeoning damage, piercing damage, slashing damage.

Special: At 6th level and every 4 levels thereafter, you can select this talent again, increasing your swarm strike’s damage by 1 size category (1d6, 1d8, 1d10, 2d6, 2d8) and gaining one of the following options each time:

Swarm strike gains the thrown (20 feet) weapon special property, or increases its range by 20 feet.
Swarm strike gains a critical threat range of 19- 20/x2. This applies before any feats or magical enhancements such as keen and stacks with exactly one of them, which would increase the threat range to 17-20/x2.
Swarm strike gains the reach weapon special property.
Thousand Stitches* (Ex)

Prerequisites: Surgical Host, 10th-level nanocyte.

You can use the Surgical Host talent to perform Heal checks to treat deadly wounds as a standard action. If you succeed at this check, you restore 2 hit points per Hit Die of the creature you’re treating. If you exceed the DC by 5 or more, you add your Wisdom bonus and Constitution bonus to the amount healed. Once you use thousand stitches on a creature, you cannot use it again until that creature has rested for at least 1 hour.

Versatile Nanites (Ex)

You’ve learned to direct your nanites in assisting you with difficult tasks, such as identifying damage, stitching wounds, reshaping your features, or further tuning your reflexes. Choose two of the following skills: Bluff, Craft, Disguise, Fly, Heal, Knowledge (engineering), or Perception. You add these skills as options to which you can apply your sheath array’s insight bonus to skill checks.

Special: You can select this talent multiple times, each time selecting different skills.

Favored Class Bonuses
Android: Gain +1 use of nanite surge per day. Each time you select this after the first, gain +1/2 use of nanite surge per day instead.
Drakorin*: Gain 1/6 of the Facial Reconfiguration nanocyte talent, even if you don’t meet its prerequisites.
Dwarf: Gain 1/6 of the Deconstructor nanocyte talent, even if you don’t meet its prerequisites.
Elf: Gain 1/6 of the Alacritous Form nanocyte talent, even if you don’t meet its prerequisites.
Gnome: Gain 1/6 of the Instant Architect nanocyte talent, even if you don’t meet its prerequisites.
Goblin: Gain 1/6 of the Rapid Reshape nanocyte talent, even if you don’t meet its prerequisites.
Half-Elf: Gain 1/6 of the Sudden Transformation nanocyte talent.
Half-orc: Add +1/2 on critical hit confirmation rolls for attacks made with a weapon formed using your gear array (maximum bonus of +5). This bonus does not stack with Critical Focus.
Halfling: Gain 1/6 of the Surgical Host nanocyte talent. If you have that talent already, this applies to the Thousand Stitches nanocyte talent instead, and you don’t have to meet that talent’s other prerequisites.
Human: Gain 1/6 of a new nanocyte talent. You must meet that talent’s prerequisites by the time you gain it in full.
Kobold: Gain 1/6 of the Myriad Forms nanocyte talent.
Ratfolk: Gain 1/6 of the Adaptable Weaponry nanocyte talent, even if you don’t meet its prerequisites.
Tengu: Gain 1/6 of the Versatile Nanites nanocyte talent.
Tiefling: Gain 1/6 of the Defensive Doppelganger nanocyte talent, even if you don’t meet its prerequisites.
